title: Normalize extreme trust timestamps without raw overflow
description: Robustness review finding in python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py lines 132-141 and python/src/lichen/crypto/key_persistence.py lines 813-870: math.isfinite() and float() are applied to arbitrary Python/JSON integers without consistently catching OverflowError. A representable JSON integer such as 10**309 causes raw OverflowError instead of ValueError/TrustStorePersistenceError; very long JSON integers can also make json.loads raise ValueError not caught by _read_json_locked. Convert under a bounded/caught validation path and add direct/API plus authenticated-document tests.
